diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says SIG, datasheet reading says Orange (Signal)
diffs.evidence: Naming difference only: both refer to the same third lead, the orange control/signal wire. Adafruit #2442 (FEETECH FS90R) product page: "we suggest connecting the orange control wire to pin 9 or 10 and using the Servo library". The part's pin 3 is SIG, role io/pwm, described as "Orange wire: 50 Hz control pulses", which matches the second reading's 'Orange (Signal)', role io. Pins 1 and 2 (brown GND, red V+) also agree. The FEETECH FS90R V2.0 spec (section 5-1 'Command signal: Pulse width modification') does not list wire colours, so the vendor page is the source for the colour.
